measurement: Re-record sIPSC with glutamate-receptor block, a fixed absolute detection threshold, noise and access resistance reported per genotype, per-animal summary; the high-chloride internal kept as the bridge to the published value (57.3 and 27.5 pA, P03) and, in matched cells, an experimenter-set low-chloride pipette (not native chloride: whole-cell chloride is set by the pipette).
separates: E-artefact from a real amplitude change; decides whether the headline datum stands. It is the cheapest and goes first.
cannot_separate: Cause of a real change; native chloride.
control_for_null: Blind to genotype; a null means the artefact is not the whole effect; the high-chloride value reproduces the published amplitude before any other reading.
unit_of_replication: animal (litter noted where bred from heterozygous pairs)
design_choice_not_finding: the threshold; whether both internals can be used in the same cell or only in matched cells

measurement: E_GABA in layer II/III pyramidal cells of knockout, heterozygote and wild-type littermates by a method that leaves chloride to the cell (gramicidin perforated patch with agonist application, with resting potential, read against threshold); somatic first, axon initial segment if feasible. Interpretable alone at one age.
separates: E-chloride (the only measurement that can test it); the sign of GABA at rest and at the burst-relevant potential.
cannot_separate: Which transporter or channel (needs a transporter manipulation); the release or receptor causes; the compartment if only somatic; primary against secondary to bursting unless paired with M09.
control_for_null: Perforation formed and stable by input-resistance and series-resistance criteria, then a vehicle time-course control as in the reference method (P08, 4 cells; the 10-30 min there is the time to form the perforation, not a stability figure); same-day positive control (rupture shifts E_Cl to the pipette value; a transporter manipulation moves E_Cl in wild type); age-matched wild type.
required_from_start: yes (the knockout and wild-type littermate comparison at P13-P17)
unit_of_replication: animal (litter where applicable); cells nested; a mixed model or per-animal means
design_choice_not_finding: which ages; that somatic E_GABA represents dendrites; the number of agonist applications per cell

measurement: Age series of knockout, heterozygote and wild-type littermates: a programme that contains M03, M01, M07 and protein across ages, across the ages the knockouts survive (they die at 3-4 weeks, P06). Wild-type reference from published layer 2/3 mIPSC time courses (PBR1) is context, not a substitute for littermates.
separates: A constant offset from a shifted or compressed time course (E-maturation); a primary from a secondary change (an age before bursting). It does not show that a defect is correctable.
cannot_separate: Mechanism within an age; ages beyond survival; a cause of the timing.
control_for_null: Wild-type littermate at every age; the same method at every age (internal chloride, temperature, analysis fixed); survivor-selection control (the oldest knockouts are survivors, and may not represent the whole); at least two ages on each side of P13-P17 if animals allow (a design assumption).
required_from_start: yes for the design (littermate wild type at every age); the whole series is a programme and is not one measurement
design_choice_not_finding: the ages; that a younger age lacks bursts (burst onset must be determined); the reference ages from other regions and readouts (P08 P09 P10 PBR1) are not this slice

measurement: mIPSC (TTX, glutamate-receptor block, GABA-A block at the end to confirm identity): amplitude distribution, frequency, rise and decay; compare with the wild-type layer 2/3 time course of PBR1 (mIPSC, 135 mM CsCl) as context.
separates: E-response (amplitude, kinetics) from E-supply (frequency); partly redundant with M05 for the response arm: worth keeping only if M05 is done, for frequency and kinetics.
cannot_separate: Release probability from site number; filling from receptor number.
control_for_null: The paired mEPSC under the same conditions (P05: mEPSC amplitude is higher, P03 context); stable-recording windows as the mEPSC analysis used.
design_choice_not_finding: the cut-off for a quantal event; pooling across cells in a KS test (do not)

measurement: Direct agonist response under TTX (puff or uncaging at a fixed distance) with an experimenter-set low-chloride pipette (not native chloride) or gramicidin.
separates: E-response from E-supply (release-independent); with M06, the only measurements that separate supply from response if M03 confirms the amplitude loss.
cannot_separate: Synaptic from extrasynaptic receptors unless the site is controlled; chloride unless M01 is paired.
control_for_null: Same pipette geometry, distance and cell size; a positive control that the puff gives a response in wild type; cell size and input resistance (Table 1, P04).
required_from_start: no (required if M03 confirms the amplitude loss)
design_choice_not_finding: agonist concentration and duration are design choices

measurement: Evoked IPSC: input-output, failure rate, paired-pulse ratio, and the E/I ratio in the same cell (holding potentials set with an experimenter-set low-chloride pipette).
control_for_null: Stimulus site and intensity fixed in absolute terms; glutamate-receptor block for IPSC isolation; a time-matched vehicle for any drug arm.
required_from_start: no (required if M03 confirms the amplitude loss)
design_choice_not_finding: the stimulus site; the isolation of monosynaptic IPSCs

measurement: Tonic GABA-A current: holding-current shift on GABA-A block with and without GABA-uptake block and a fixed ambient-GABA condition.
control_for_null: Block agent alone; condition fixed because tonic current depends on uptake and ambient GABA (P12: 170 against 12 pA; 9 against 41 pA, in layer 5 on clamped internals).
design_choice_not_finding: which ambient-GABA and uptake condition; what counts as change

measurement: Interneuron identity and number per animal in layer II/III: PV, SST and VIP markers, GAD65/67 and VGAT. Low-yield as a stand-alone count: a reporter line identifying the recorded cells in M01 and M06 adds more, and a hippocampal count deficit is already in the registry (P14).
separates: Interneuron loss within E-supply; identity of the recorded cells (P04).
control_for_null: Age-matched wild type; a null does not exclude lost release (pair with M06).

measurement: Wild-type slices driven into a burst state, read with the M03 sIPSC, M07 tonic current and M01 E_GABA.
separates: E-compensation (activity-dependent) and E-chloride-secondary (chloride shift as a consequence of bursting) from a primary change.
control_for_null: Matched burst rate and the same state conditions measured (S3 section 4 item 1).
design_choice_not_finding: how the burst state is driven; whether it resembles the knockout burst

measurement: Matched non-GABAergic suppression of bursts titrated to the same percent of evoked synaptic charge removed, carried from S3 arm A6, for any drug arm of Q5.
separates: Whether a GABA-A or chloride-directed burst reduction is more than a generic cut in drive.
cannot_separate: Which mechanism within the GABA-A arm.
control_for_null: Quantified on two metrics (charge; peak or slope); time-matched vehicle and washout where the tool reverses.
blocks_which_explanation: E-artefact for drug arms; makes Q5 rows interpretable
design_choice_not_finding: the matching metric (a design choice); the common axis
